Governmental balances: beginning/ending 'cash' = fund balance 646,539 / 667,213 from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Change in Fund Balance (p5); total assets on p4 are 667,215 (cash 449,284 + county treasurer 16,211 + investments 201,720). Transfers: p5 labels the 105,128 'Transfers to other funds' under other financing sources, but the arithmetic, p8 ('Transfers from other funds') and p3 (governmental transfers in from business-type) show it is a transfer IN from the utilities; recorded as transfers_in, and as business_type.transfers_net -105,128. Grants and donations 47,052 (parks 46,432 + library 620, p10) are printed under other financing sources, below Total receipts; recorded as a receipt (donations/contributions, review) with outside_printed_total, since grants are revenue (p3 shows them as operating grants and contributions). Business-type: the proprietary revenues/expenses statement (report p8-9) is not in the trimmed PDF; receipts/disbursements by fund taken from the Statement of Activities (p3), including business-type interest 56,383 and other misc 15,186; disbursements include depreciation 213,579 (p7 cash flow). Business-type measure = net position (4,002,068 to 3,735,409, p3). Detail: General Fund departmental combining schedule (p10) used instead of the General Fund budget schedule (p8) to avoid double counting; its department columns are recorded per department, Recycling and Landfill under public safety (statement of activities public safety 235,848 = Police 213,786 + Recycling 20,496 + Landfill 1,566), Municipal Building under general government, Streets column, Parks/Pool/Library under culture/recreation. Per p8 the Streets intergovernmental 143,099 = highway allocation 142,099 + incentive payment 1,000. Transfers in detail are in other financing; the grant/donation lines are revenue with outside_printed_total.
